<thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the base peak at m/z 194.0862 corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of 193.0789 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 intensity ≈ 33 %) indicates the presence of one chlorine atom. Solving 12 C + 1.007825 H + 34.968853 Cl = 193.0789 Da yields the formula C₁₂H₁₄Cl, which matches the exact mass within a few ppm and the observed isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H14Cl</final_answer>
